** Registration is Open for the 2026 APRN Roundtable
------------------------------------------------------------

The NCSBN APRN Roundtable (https://www.ncsbn.org/events/2026-aprn-roundtab=
le)  is an opportunity for advanced practice registered nurse (APRN) stake=
holders to discuss matters of common interest which impact APRN regulation=
=2E

This one-day=2C virtual conference on Wednesday=2C April 29=2C 2026=2C is=
 a unique opportunity for nursing regulators=2C professionals=2C educators=
=2C professional societies=2C credentialing agencies and others interested=
 in APRN regulation to discuss matters of common interest.
Register Today (https://cvent.me/aWDe0D)
The program objectives for this year=E2=80=99s APRN Roundtable:
* Analyze the evolving regulatory impact of telehealth on APRN practice.
* Discuss current legislative updates to inform APRN policy and regulatory=
 frameworks.
* Examine the evolution of the APRN Consensus Model.
* Evaluate the future of APRN education and workforce development.
* Discuss RN experience requirements in APRN education.
* Discuss strategies to advance regulatory policy for APRN-led medical spa=
s.

The day will conclude with a panel discussion with representatives of the=
 Licensure=2C Accreditation=2C Certification and Education (LACE) Network=
=2C entitled=2C "The LACE Network: Communication=2C Collaboration and the=
 APRN Consensus Model."

View the agenda (https://web.cvent.com/event/e6e56cfb-6cb8-4d42-8e0e-c4889=
eb28736/websitePage:24578342-ded5-4185-8237-9077e39d1830) .
Registration deadline April 15=2C 2026

Your user account is registered successfully. We are happy that you have chosen NordLEI!
